shared_elements: arms rendered as simple bent limbs
justification: Both surfaces present a highly schematic frontal anthropomorph with simplified bent arms accompanied by circular disc motifs and short linear marks, which is about as generic as figural iconography gets. The differences dominate: A is a static, self-contained relief body whose disc sits centrally on the torso beneath a headdress, with no action or accompanying scene, whereas B shows an active figure brandishing a huge weapon among boat-like signs and scattered cup marks — a narrative scene rather than an isolated effigy.
